10 استعكد He (a bird) drew close, or betook himself, to a thing, in fear of the birds of prey. (O, K.) And استعكد بِحَجَرٍ, or بِشَجَرٍ, He (a [lizard of the species termed] ضَبّ) betook himself, or repaired, for refuge, or protection, to a stone, or to trees, in fear of the eagle or the hawk. (T, M, O, TA.) ―
-b2- And, said of water, It collected. (TA.) ―
-b3- See also 1, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
